meaning: There are two specified routes on Nat, each pairing a graph interpretation with PhysicalGround.Route parameters, that have the same anchor and the same extension for every restricted path formula (the anchor reaches exactly the even numbers), and both satisfy the ST I q.14 a.1 reading Route.Immaterial; in the first the anchor is composite and has intellect, in the second it is neither composite nor has intellect.
